jobs.title: Product Manager Martech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a Product Manager you are the end-to-end champion of our marketing technology solutions. This hybrid role is responsible for the entire product lifecycle—from defining the long-term vision and market strategy ("The What") to leading the tactical execution and sprint delivery ("The How"). You will serve as the single point of accountability, ensuring that our Martech stack is strategically aligned with business goals while maintaining a high-velocity, high-quality development output.

Tasks & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Roadmapping
• Vision & Strategy: Define and communicate the product vision and long-term roadmap for our Martech ecosystem.
• Market Analysis: Conduct research on marketing trends, API integrations, and the competitive landscape to ensure product-market fit.
• Business Alignment: Partner with the Business Owner to ensure the product delivers measurable ROI and supports the company’s broader financial objectives.

Tactical Execution & Delivery
• Backlog & Sprint Management: Own the end-to-end backlog; draft, refine, and prioritize user stories to ensure the development team has a clear path for every sprint.
• Agile Facilitation: Lead sprint planning, define sprint goals, and participate in daily stand-ups to unblock the Scrum team and ensure timely increments.
• Functional Specifications: Translate marketing requirements into clear technical specifications.

Stakeholder & Team Orchestration
• Cross-Functional Bridge: Serve as the primary liaison between Marketing/Sales stakeholders and the technical development team.
• Quality Assurance: Validate that every product increment meets the "Definition of Done" and fulfills the strategic intent established in the roadmap.

Must Haves:
• Minimum Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
• Previous experience in marketing platforms and product ownership
• Minimum 5 year of experience within Martech
• Dual-Competency Expertise: Proven ability to balance high-level strategic thinking with meticulous, detail-oriented execution in an Agile environment.
• Martech Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of the marketing technology landscape and data privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA).
• Agile Mastery: Expert-level experience with Scrum frameworks, backlog grooming, and product management software.
• Technical Literacy: Ability to discuss API capabilities, data schemas, and system architecture with engineers while explaining business value to business leaders.
• Analytical Mindset: Strong capability to use data and customer insights to make prioritization decisions.
• Language Skills: Fluency in English required, German is a plus

jobs.title: System Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
In dieser Rolle werden Sie die Produktion im Bereich Sensors and Cartridges (S&C) Manufacturing unseres Kunden in Rotkreuz in mehreren Bereichen unterstützen. Einerseits, indem Sie den reibungslosen OT- und System-Support für die laufenden Produktionen des Sensor and Cartridges Manufacturing Networks sicherstellen. Andererseits unterstützen Sie die Projektteams bei Kapazitäts-Erweiterungsprojekten aus Sicht der Systemtechnik. Zusätzlich übernehmen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle innerhalb des Teams, in dem Sie übergreifend als Experte im Bereich IT/OT-Infrastruktur, Netzwerke und Systemintegration/Erweiterung unterstützen.

Startdatum: Nov/Dez 2026 oder Jan/Feb/Mär 2027
Enddatum: 12-monatiger Vertrag (mit hohen Chancen auf Verlängerung)
Arbeitspensum: 100%, mit der Option auf einen Tag Homeoffice pro Woche
Arbeitsort: Rotkreuz
Arbeitsmodel: Personalverleih

In dieser Rolle sind Sie massgeblich involviert, um technische IT/OT-Anforderungen zu definieren und IT-Architekturen sowie Feinspezifikationen auszuarbeiten. Des Weiteren werden Sie Änderungen an Servern, Netzwerken und IT/OT-Systemen im Produktionsumfeld koordinieren und durchführen. Sie sind zusammen mit dem Team verantwortlich für das System-Management und stellen den Lifecycle der OT-Infrastruktur der Produktionsanlagen sowie produktionsnaher Anwendungen der Qualitätskontrolle (QC) sicher. Sie werden Teil eines hochqualifizierten Teams von +11 Ingenieuren sein, welches das gesamte Sensor & Cartridges Product Portfolio betreut.

Deine Aufgaben:
• Selbstständige Arbeit mit und Administration von IT/OT-Infrastrukturen (Server, Clients, Netzwerke, Virtualisierungsumgebungen, OT Systemen) zur Durchführung von Projekten und Wartungsarbeiten
• Direkte Unterstützung bei der Fehlersuche und Problemlösung auf System-, Applikations- und Netzwerkebene in enger Abstimmung mit Automation Engineers, Global IT und Lieferanten
• Durchführung von Korrektur- und Präventivmaßnahmen zur Verbesserung der OT/IT-Infrastruktur und Systemstabilität
• Unterstützung und Durchführung der Wartungsaktivitäten (Patch-Management, Updates) in Bezug auf alle lokalen IT/OT-Systeme
• Unterstützung der Inbetriebnahmeaktivitäten aus Sicht der Systemtechnik (z. B. Bereitstellung von Servern, Netzwerkanbindungen für Erweiterungs- oder Modernisierungsprojekte)
• Erstellung verschiedener System-Dokumente im Lebenszyklus (System-Design-Spezifikation, IT-Architektur-Diagramme, Arbeitsanweisungen) und Sicherstellung deren Aktualität im GMP-Umfeld
• Monitoring, Incident Management und Lebenszyklusmanagement der Server-Infrastruktur (inkl. User Management / Active Directory, Backup Management und Audit Trail Reviews)
• Regelmäßige Kommunikation und Abstimmung mit dem IT-Team
• Mitwirkung / Mitentwicklung von Digitalen Strategien und Konzepten

Dein Profil:
• Min. abgeschlossene Aus- oder Weiterbildung im Bereich Informatik, Systemtechnik, IT-Infrastruktur oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich
• Min. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich System Engineering / IT-Administration/ Automation Engineering
• Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Administration von Server-Betriebssystemen (Windows/Linux), und Netzwerktechnik (LAN, VLAN, Firewalls), OT-Systemen
• Berufserfahrung im streng regulierten Umfeld, von Vorteil im GxP Umfeld oder IVD Bereich
• Berufserfahrung in der IT/OT-Projektarbeit von Vorteil
• Gute Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich
• Fachübergreifendes Know-How an der Schnittstelle IT und Produktion (Industrie 4.0, Operational Technology / OT)
• Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und analytische Herangehensweise bei komplexen Systemstörungen

Inoltre, coordina e implementa le modifiche a server, reti e sistemi IT/OT nell'ambiente di produzione. Insieme al team, sono responsabili della gestione del sistema e assicurano il ciclo di vita dell'infrastruttura OT degli impianti di produzione e delle applicazioni di controllo della qualità (QC). Sarete parte di un team altamente qualificato di +11 ingegneri che supervisioneranno l'intero portafoglio prodotti Sensor & Cartridges.

I vostri compiti:
• Lavoro indipendente con e amministrazione di infrastrutture IT/OT (server, client, reti, ambienti di virtualizzazione, sistemi OT) per la realizzazione di progetti e lavori di manutenzione
• Supporto diretto per la risoluzione dei problemi e la risoluzione dei problemi a livello di sistema, applicazione e rete in stretto coordinamento con Automation Engineers, Global IT e fornitori
• Attuazione di misure correttive e preventive per migliorare le infrastrutture OT/IT e la stabilità dei sistemi
• Supporto e implementazione di attività di manutenzione (gestione di patch, aggiornamenti) in relazione a tutti i sistemi IT/OT locali
• Supporto per le attività di messa in servizio dal punto di vista della tecnologia di sistema (ad esempio la fornitura di server, connessioni di rete per progetti di estensione o modernizzazione)
• Creazione di vari documenti di sistema nel ciclo di vita (specificazione di progettazione del sistema, diagrammi di architettura IT, istruzioni di lavoro) e garantire la loro tempestività nell'ambiente GMP
• Monitoraggio, gestione degli incidenti e gestione del ciclo di vita dell'infrastruttura del server (compresa la gestione degli utenti / directory attiva, la gestione di backup e le recensioni dei trail di audit)
• Comunicazione e coordinamento regolari con il team IT
• Partecipazione / co-sviluppo di strategie e concetti digitali

Il tuo profilo:
• Min. Istruzione o formazione completa in informatica, ingegneria dei sistemi, infrastruttura IT o un campo comparabile
• Min. 5 anni di esperienza professionale in Ingegneria del sistema / Amministrazione IT / Ingegneria dell'automazione
• Conoscenza approfondita nell'amministrazione dei sistemi operativi server (Windows/Linux) e della tecnologia di rete (LAN, VLAN, firewall), sistemi OT
• Esperienza professionale in un ambiente strettamente regolamentato, utile in un ambiente GxP o in una zona IVD
• Esperienza professionale nel lavoro di progetto IT/OT è utile
• Buone competenze tedesche e molto buone inglese sono richiesti

descriptionByLocale.en:
In this role, you will support the production in the area of Sensors and Cartridges (S&C) Manufacturing of our customer in Rotkreuz in several areas. On the one hand, by ensuring smooth OT and system support for the ongoing productions of the Sensor and Cartridges Manufacturing Network. On the other hand, you support the project teams in capacity expansion projects from the point of view of system technology. In addition, you take on a decisive role within the team, in which you support as an expert in the field of IT/OT infrastructure, networks and system integration/extension.

Start date: Nov/Dez 2026 or Jan/Feb/Mär 2027
End date: 12-month contract (with high chances of renewal)
Workload: 100%, with the option to one day home office per week
Place of work: Rotkreuz
Work model: Staff rental

In this role, you will be significantly involved in defining technical IT/OT requirements and developing IT architectures and fine specifications. Furthermore, you will coordinate and implement changes to servers, networks and IT/OT systems in the production environment. Together with the team, they are responsible for system management and ensure the lifecycle of the OT infrastructure of the production facilities as well as production-related quality control (QC) applications. You will be part of a highly qualified team of +11 engineers who will oversee the entire Sensor & Cartridges product portfolio.

Your tasks:
• Independent work with and administration of IT/OT infrastructures (servers, clients, networks, virtualization environments, OT systems) for carrying out projects and maintenance work
• Direct support for troubleshooting and problem solving at the system, application and network level in close coordination with Automation Engineers, Global IT and suppliers
• Implementation of corrective and preventive measures to improve OT/IT infrastructure and system stability
• Support and implementation of maintenance activities (patch management, updates) in relation to all local IT/OT systems
• Support for commissioning activities from the point of view of system technology (e.g. provision of servers, network connections for extension or modernization projects)
• Creation of various system documents in the life cycle (system design specification, IT architecture diagrams, work instructions) and ensuring their timeliness in the GMP environment
• Monitoring, incident management and lifecycle management of the server infrastructure (including user management / active directory, backup management and audit trail reviews)
• Regular communication and coordination with the IT team
• Participation / co-development of digital strategies and concepts

Your profile:
• Min. Completed education or training in computer science, systems engineering, IT infrastructure or a comparable field
• Min. 5 years of professional experience in System Engineering / IT Administration / Automation Engineering
• In-depth knowledge in the administration of server operating systems (Windows/Linux), and network technology (LAN, VLAN, firewalls), OT systems
• Professional experience in a strictly regulated environment, beneficial in a GxP environment or IVD area
• Professional experience in IT/OT project work is beneficial
• Good German and very good English skills are required
• Cross-disciplinary know-how at the interface IT and production (Industry 4.0, Operational Technology / OT)
• Rapid comprehension and analytical approach to complex system failures
• Questioning conventional thinking patterns in IT operations

jobs.title: Communication Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
This is a senior expert position has a global scope and includes the overall responsibility to develop integrated communications launch plans across our clients diagnostic portfolio and connect as appropriate with Pharma partners to drive the most impact. In this temporary position, you will report to the Head of Diagnostics Global Functions Communications and partner with colleagues in the Diagnostics Global Customer Service organization and Communications teams to deliver on the communications strategy, planning and execution.

Start Date: asap
End Date: 12-month contract (with the option of extension)
Workload: 100%, with min. 3 days onsite per week and some travel activities to Rotkreuz
Location: Basel
Workmodel: Contracting

In this role you will be primarily responsible for engaging and inspiring key stakeholders and internal audiences through the delivery of communications strategy, planning and execution of communications tactics and activities designed to inform and engage Diagnostics employees. As a communications expert you will support on topics such as change communication and function-specific content creation.
You rely on effective teamwork and collaboration with the broader Diagnostics Communications community, and work in partnership with your colleagues in the functions to define objectives, approach and areas of focus. You embrace an agile mindset and are energised by change. You advise on relevant communication approaches and support their implementation. You want to be a key player in transforming Diagnostics and develop new leadership skills in a fast-paced, rapidly changing industry/environment.

Your responsibilies
• In alignment with your colleagues in the Business Partner and Communications teams, drive planning and delivering integrated communications strategies, narratives and campaigns that engage and align stakeholders at both a cross function and team-specific level
• Align Communications strategy, goals, and objectives to overall priorities
• Provide support on high-value, impactful employee and change communications
• Support the development of communications tools and strategies to engage and inspire a diverse workforce, equip leaders with the skills to effectively inspire their organisations, and equip colleagues with the skills and capabilities they need to maximise their interactions with stakeholders
• Support end-to-end integrated communication planning including measurement against objectives
• Develop and maintain broad-based knowledge of the Diagnostics Customer Service organisation; use knowledge of business and communications insights, metrics, expertise, and decision principles to effectively diagnose topics with a wide range of complexity
• Stay abreast of internal and external developments, industry trends, as these pertain to strategic communication and ‘new ways of working’ priorities

Your Profil:
• Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Public Relations or related field, or equivalent combination of education and work-related experience, required
• 5+ years of experience in communications, with a focus on external communications preferably gained in the pharmaceutical or diagnostics industry
• Ability to manage indirectly: can ensure outcomes through indirect leadership
• International or global work experience
• Demonstrable abilities to develop and manage global communications strategies, plans, activities and teams
• Outstanding strategic agility: thorough grasp of the healthcare/diagnostics industry and regularly applies such to create robust and innovative strategies
• Outstanding consulting skills: active listening skills, ability to extract and quickly process key information, summarise key needs or interests of internal customers, and provide targeted and appropriate coaching, insights and recommendations
• Excellent influencing and negotiation skills: consistently optimises results through skillful collaboration with others and driving excellence through influence without authority
• Outstanding interpersonal and partnering skills: proven track record of building strong and sustainable relationships with internal and external partners/stakeholders and experience working effectively in a networked, matrix environment
• Self-motivation: able to thrive in a non-hierarchical, self-organising environment, where teams form around projects and initiatives
• Fluency in English (verbal and written)

Job profile
• Administration - Marketing
• Basel-Stadt
• Contracting
• Full Time
• asap - 12-month contract (with the option of extension)
• Communications, Stakeholder communication

Job benefits
• Central location
• Events

• Further education
• Good public transport connection
• Home Office
• Modern workspace
• Strong team spirit

descriptionByLocale.it:
Questa è una posizione di esperto senior ha un ambito globale e include la responsabilità generale di sviluppare i piani di lancio di comunicazioni integrate nel nostro portafoglio diagnostico dei clienti e connettersi come appropriato con i partner Pharma per guidare il maggior impatto. In questa posizione temporanea, riferirai al responsabile delle funzioni globali di diagnostica Comunicazioni e partner con i colleghi dell'organizzazione e delle comunicazioni globali di Diagnostics per fornire la strategia di comunicazione, la pianificazione e l'esecuzione.

Data di inizio: asap
Data di fine: contratto di 12 mesi (con l'opzione di estensione)
Carico di lavoro: 100%, con minimo 3 giorni in loco a settimana e alcune attività di viaggio a Rotkreuz
Posizione: Basilea
Modello di lavoro: Contratto

In questo ruolo sarete principalmente responsabili di coinvolgere e ispirare le parti interessate chiave e il pubblico interno attraverso la consegna della strategia di comunicazione, la pianificazione e l'esecuzione delle tattiche di comunicazione e delle attività progettate per informare e coinvolgere i dipendenti di Diagnostics. In qualità di esperto di comunicazioni supporterai argomenti come la comunicazione di cambiamento e la creazione di contenuti specifici per le funzioni.
Fai affidamento sul lavoro di squadra efficace e sulla collaborazione con la più ampia comunità di comunicazioni diagnostiche e lavori in collaborazione con i tuoi colleghi nelle funzioni per definire obiettivi, approcci e aree di messa a fuoco. Si abbraccia una mentalità agile e sono eccitati dal cambiamento. Si consiglia di approcci di comunicazione pertinenti e sostenere la loro attuazione. Si desidera essere un giocatore chiave nella trasformazione diagnostica e sviluppare nuove competenze di leadership in un settore / ambiente rapido e in rapida evoluzione.

Le tue responsabilità
• In linea con i colleghi dei team Business Partner e Communications, guidare la pianificazione e fornire strategie di comunicazione integrate, narrazioni e campagne che coinvolgono e allineano le parti interessate sia a livello di funzione trasversale che di livello specifico del team
• Allineare la strategia, gli obiettivi e gli obiettivi delle comunicazioni alle priorità generali
• Fornire supporto su un dipendente di alto valore e le comunicazioni di cambiamento
• Sostenere lo sviluppo di strumenti di comunicazione e strategie per coinvolgere e ispirare una forza lavoro diversificata, dotare i leader delle competenze per ispirare efficacemente le loro organizzazioni e dotare i colleghi delle competenze e delle capacità necessarie per massimizzare le loro interazioni con gli stakeholder.
• Supporta la pianificazione integrata di comunicazione end-to-end, compresa la misurazione contro gli obiettivi
• Sviluppare e mantenere una vasta conoscenza dell'organizzazione del Servizio Clienti Diagnostici; utilizzare la conoscenza delle conoscenze aziendali e delle comunicazioni, metriche, competenze e principi decisionali per diagnosticare efficacemente gli argomenti con una vasta gamma di complessità
• Rimanere al passo con gli sviluppi interni ed esterni, le tendenze del settore, in quanto questi riguardano la comunicazione strategica e le priorità «nuovi modi di lavoro»

Il tuo Profil:
• Corso di laurea minimo in giornalismo, comunicazioni, relazioni pubbliche o campo correlato, o combinazione equivalente di istruzione e di esperienza legata al lavoro, richiesto
• 5+ anni di esperienza nella comunicazione, con un focus sulle comunicazioni esterne preferibilmente acquisite nel settore farmaceutico o diagnostico
• Capacità di gestire indirettamente: può garantire i risultati attraverso la leadership indiretta
• Esperienza lavorativa internazionale o globale
• Capacità dimostrabili di sviluppare e gestire strategie di comunicazione globale, piani, attività e team
• Straordinaria agilità strategica: comprensione approfondita del settore sanitario/diagnostico e lo applica regolarmente per creare strategie robuste e innovative
• Competenze di consulenza eccezionali: competenze di ascolto attive, capacità di estrarre e elaborare rapidamente le informazioni chiave, riassumere le esigenze chiave o gli interessi dei clienti interni, e fornire coaching mirato e appropriato, approfondimenti e raccomandazioni

jobs.description:
For our Pharma client in Schaffausen, we are looking for an Enablement Engineer who has good knowledge of MES systems

Your responsibilities
• Analyse capability and training needs with project managers, process owners, subject-matter experts, Manufacturing, Quality, IT, Automation, and Validation.
• Translate manufacturing processes, approved procedures, and PAS-X functionality into role-based learning objectives, curricula, and practical user guidance.
• Develop and maintain instructor-led and digital learning content, exercises, presentations, simulations, quick-reference guides, manuals, and other support materials.
• Plan, coordinate, and deliver classroom, group, individual, and hands-on PAS-X training for production employees, support functions, key users, and internal trainers.
• Assess learning effectiveness and user readiness through knowledge checks, practical exercises, observations, feedback, and readiness reporting.
• Provide floor-level support during deployment and hypercare, coaching users and resolving or routing process- and system-related questions.
• Capture recurring user challenges and work with relevant teams to improve training, documentation, business processes, or system configuration.
• Maintain training records, completion status, evaluation results, capability gaps, risks, and progress reports in line with applicable quality requirements.

Required qualifications and experience
• Degree or comparable qualification in engineering, life sciences, IT, business administration, educational sciences, or a related field.
• Experience developing and delivering technical, process-based, or system training; experience with PAS-X or another MES is strongly preferred.
• Understanding of manufacturing processes and the ability to independently connect operational workflows with system functionality.
• Experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other regulated manufacturing environment is preferred; GxP knowledge is an advantage.
• Experience supporting system implementation, change, go-live preparation, hypercare, train-the-trainer activities, or key-user networks is beneficial.
• Strong instructional design, adult-learning, facilitation, coaching, communication, and presentation skills.
• Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented working style, with strong collaboration skills and attention to documentation quality.
• Fluent German and English, both written and spoken.

• Contracting
• Full Time

Ce rôle est essentiel pour soutenir la transformation des données à l'échelle mondiale, en mettant l'accent sur la migration des instruments de diagnostic, des consommables et de l'emballage des données des systèmes existants vers la nouvelle plateforme S/4HANA Data Management.

Responsabilités :
• Soutenir un projet mondial de migration de données pour migrer de grandes séries de données de législation chimique de la solution SAP EHSM actuelle vers la nouvelle solution dans EHSM S4 HANA.

• Expertise en matière de migration de la conformité chimique, de la réglementation ou de données sensibles similaires tout en respectant des normes strictes d'intégrité des données et de gouvernance.

• Expérience de l'utilisation des systèmes de gestion des données de déclaration de matériel pour l'évaluation, la maintenance et la vérification exhaustives des ensembles de données de déclaration de matériel à grande échelle (comme SAP EH&S(M) ou équivalents).

jobs.description:
You’ll be part of building design maturity for our diagnostic client with peers who are passionate, energetic and caring in a connected, multicultural, highly motivated team.
For this role we are looking for a leader who confidently manages the overall research delivery operations, builds strong relationships with both team members and customers, and impacts projects and business by enabling customer-centric best practices and strategic thinking.

Start Date: Dec 2026 or Jan 2027
End Date: 6-month contract (with the option of another 6-month extension)
Workload: 60 - 100%
Location: Rotkreuz
Workmodel: Contracting

Your responsibilies
• Supports more senior roles in shaping approaches and pitching work to clients
• Supports more senior roles in managing day-to-day activities, and understands stakeholders’ expectations and course-correct deviations in the project plan
• Leads the discussion about domain and regulatory context with clients, users and customers, and incorporates these inputs into design solutions
• Takes part in CXSD work packages aimed to create more efficient and effective processes and practices
• Supports constructive critique and personal feedback opportunities within the team, such as retrospectives, and suggest actions to take
• Creates content to support thought leadership initiatives
• Helps define overarching story and frameworks to be used during client presentations
• Communicates storyline to clients and potential users and customers, as appropriate
• Represents the CXSD team in clients events and meetings, and articulates the business value of design
• Actively captures value stories on projects and shares internally or via thought leadership
• Identifies inter-dependencies or risks early on, and propose solutions on how to address them
• Oversees and evaluates new team members during ramp-up - Acts as a buddy

Your Profil:
• Strong in-depth knowledge in Design Research and broad knowledge of related design disciplines (i.e. Product Design and Service Design)
• Ability to orchestrate the research activity across multiple projects
• Proven track record in creating experience strategy based on customer insights
• Ability to manage both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies and different data set integration
• Ability to contribute to several products or services that have come to market with ownership of deliverables
• Experience in guiding more junior designers on projects that require in-depth knowledge of healthcare solution areas and related regulations
• Minimum 5-10 years of experience in med. Tech or regulated environments
• Great presentation skills and communicates ideas, solutions and deliverables effectively and logically when asked to
• Strategic thinker and results oriented able to drive experience and business conversations
• Great team player able to generate consensus and buy-in in complex organizational contexts
• Curious and humble: develop a learner approach to research and design challenges
• Creative problem solvers are able to look for the best solution to address the challenge
• Data driven to ground decision making on a robust understanding of the problem space
• Often the "back-bone" of projects from beginning to end
• Usually leads the design process of one or two main projects and also manages design research discussions around similar projects or similar environments
• Able to communicate organizational and product development changes to cross-chapter team members and other designers
• Observes project challenges and discusses contingencies and mitigation ideas with project lead
• Demonstrates resilience in the face of failure, obstacles, or project changes
• Has a deep commitment to the long-term project goals and is able to direct product and design team attention to them
• Thinks logically and critically about client problems and is methodical and process-oriented on tackling those problems
• Able to work and to manage their project development independently. Requires only minimal guidance from more senior roles
• Knows how to independently engage and communicate with the clients customers and potential customers to enable customer centricity within projects

jobs.description:
Für unseren Kunden aus der Energiebranche in Bern, suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n, motivierte:n und aufgeschlossene:n Softwaretester:in für Webapplikationen im Energiehandelskontext.

In diesem Projekt unterstützt du die Qualitätssicherung eines neu entwickelten Zeitreihenmanagementsystems, das eine bestehende Kernanwendung ablösen wird. Du stellst durch strukturierte Testaktivitäten sicher, dass die neue Lösung über den gesamten Projektverlauf hinweg stabil, zuverlässig und fachlich korrekt funktioniert und begleitest den Weg bis zum geplanten Go-Live.

• Unterstützung und Begleitung von Integrationstests sowie der Cut-over- und Go-Live-Phase
• Sicherstellung einer nachvollziehbaren Testdokumentation und Unterstützung bei der fachlichen Abnahme der Lösung

Dein Profil:

• Erfahrung im Testen von Webapplikationen auf Basis von ASP.NET Blazor und C#
• Praxis im Bereich API-Testing , idealerweise mit Postman , sowie Erfahrung mit Integrations- und Schnittstellentests
• Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft und Verständnis für fachliche Prozesse, Zeitreihendaten und Datenflüsse von Vorteil
• Analytische, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
• Klare und adressatengerechte Kommunikationsfähigkeit in Deutsch und Englisch

Zusätzlich von Vorteil:
• Erfahrung in der Testautomatisierung für UI-, API- oder Regressionstests
• Kenntnisse von PostgreSQL , TimescaleDB / TigerData sowie Zeitreihen-Datenbanken
• Erfahrung in agilen Softwareentwicklungsprojekten und in der Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Projektteams

• Experience in the energy industry and understanding of professional processes, time series data and data flows beneficial
• Analytical, structured and careful working method with a high degree of personal responsibility

jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for a Senior QA Specialist responsible for QC microbiology ensuring adherence to standards and compliance with GMP regulation in DPS.

Location: Stein

Contract duration: 6 months

Workload: 60%

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to work on growth projects as per site quality objectives and strategic goals. Ensure that project timelines and deliverables under the responsibility of QA/QC are fulfilled.
• Provides guidance and quality oversight for QC.
• Support growth projects and act as primary point of contact in QA for implementation of gLIMS (laboratory execution system).
• Represents the QA support and guidance to the Quality Control (QC) department and ensures that GMP requirements are met and SOPs are followed.
• Review and Approval of GMP relevant documents from quality control, including SOPs with focus on implementation of gLIMS.
• Supervise and execute GMP compliance activities like changes (CRs), document management, non-conformities (DRs).
• Write or revise SOPs in the area of expertise and be the owner of these documents.
• Support QA for QC raw data review, as deemed required.
• Meet internal and external guidelines regarding quality and safety (quality manuals, regulatory GMP guidelines, health authority guidance, SOPs, HSE, etc.)
• Management and reporting of KPIs.
